programme.summary: AUA's MD route combines pre-clinical study in Antigua with clinical sciences at affiliated teaching hospitals. Students Traffic can assess academic route, create a direct-cost and living-cost plan, and organise an application file for the active intake.

fee.notes: The administrative fee includes required educational resources. BLS ($85) and ACLS ($250) can apply in specified pre-clinical terms; FIU rotations add $450 per credit-week. Housing, food and personal costs are separate.

admissions.overview: AUA uses a holistic admissions review; MCAT is one input rather than the only factor. The current page recommends Biology, General and Organic Chemistry, Physics, English and Mathematics coursework.
steps: Submit the MD application or AMCAS application through AUA's route
Provide academic records and the requested supporting information
Complete admissions review and any interview steps requested
Accept the offer, pay required deposits and complete arrival/housing actions
restrictions: Applicants must meet the programme's academic and professional-suitability review
Clinical placement is not guaranteed in the United States; immigration decisions are made by US authorities

programme.academics: The current consumer disclosure describes two basic-science years in Antigua followed by 84 weeks of clinical sciences. The academic calendar identifies an eight-week FM1/IM1 rotation at participating sites; clinical progression remains subject to programme requirements and placement availability.
programme.recognition: CAAM-HP independently records AUA as Accreditation with Conditions for 2024-2028. WDOMS records a current English-language MD and an Intealth recognised-accreditation policy note. These are programme-status facts, not a guarantee of individual licensing, visa or residency outcomes.
programme.housingSupport: AUA offers on-campus and selected third-party housing. Current housing information says university-approved options are first-deposit, first-served; a $1,000 housing-damage deposit applies, and utilities/internet are generally separate. The new-student guide requires first-term pre-clinical students to live in university housing and lists a $500 seat deposit plus $750 housing deposit.
programme.scholarships: AUA publishes scholarships and grants, and its financial-aid pages describe US federal, private and Canadian options for eligible students. Funding eligibility differs by citizenship and loan programme; a personalised funding plan should separate confirmed aid from competitive scholarships.
faqs: How long is AUA's MD?
AUA discloses two years of basic sciences in Antigua and 84 weeks of clinical sciences.
What are the Fall 2026 direct charges?

Pre-clinical tuition is USD 20,335 per trimester plus USD 4,000 administrative and USD 1,000 health-insurance charges. Clinical tuition is USD 22,850 plus USD 3,425 administrative and USD 1,000 insurance charges per trimester.
What does the administrative fee include?
AUA says it covers required educational resources, so standard textbook purchases are not additional required costs.
Where are clinical rotations?
AUA describes affiliated teaching-hospital clinical sciences and publishes participating FM1/IM1 sites. Site availability and immigration rules mean no individual US placement is guaranteed.
Is AUA accredited?
CAAM-HP lists Accreditation with Conditions for 2024-2028. WDOMS also records the current MD programme and recognised-accreditation note.
What academic preparation is expected?
AUA recommends Biology, General and Organic Chemistry, Physics, English and Mathematics. Its committee also considers experience, service and broader application evidence.
What housing is available?
AUA offers on-campus and selected third-party housing, allocated on a first-deposit basis. Utilities and internet are generally additional.
Are scholarships available?
AUA publishes scholarships and grants. Awards and loan access depend on eligibility and are not assured by admission.
What support is available?
The Education Enhancement Department supports pre-clinical study skills, learning and progression; AUA also publishes new-student and housing guidance.
Can I use US federal aid?
AUA states that eligible students may access the William D. Ford Federal Direct Loan Program; eligibility must be assessed against the active federal rules.
